title: Storybook
description: The story told as a children's picture-book page: a storybook opening, a few big friendly beats, and a closing line. The words get simpler and warmer; the facts stay exactly as the article gives them.

opening.description: The opening line of the storybook page, in simple words: who the story is about and where it happens, as the article gives them. Start it like a story ('In a small town by the sea, …'), never with a fact the article doesn't give.

beats.description: The story in order, one beat per thing that happens. Each beat is one short, simple sentence a child could follow, and every number in it is copied from the article exactly.

picture.description: One emoji that pictures the beat, chosen by you: "🚂", "🌧️", "🎉". Decoration only; it carries no fact.

text.description: One beat of the story in simple words: "The little train carried 9,000 people across the harbour every day."

closing.description: Optional: the last line of the page, what the story means or what happens next, only as the article gives it. The template adds 'And so' in front of it, so start with a small letter: "nobody in the town needed a timetable any more".
